mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates applied to equity cash flows and compressing future returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when UNRATE crosses above 7.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising demand (GDPC1) and falling supply (INDPRO) signals an overheating economy, prompting market anticipation of a correction and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05) or the effect is not statistically significant over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO index reflects weakening demand or rising inflationary pressures, compressing growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during sustained supply increases, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 233 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central banks to tighten policy and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when CPIAUCSL crosses above 233, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market signalified by rising employment (PAYEMS) alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens growth prospects and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05) or the effect is not statistically significant over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in demand (GDPC1) during a monetary tightening cycle suggests resilient economic activity, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite sustained GDPC1 increases, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during FEDFUNDS declines in late-cycle periods, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
